name: Watson and Mary Morstan's Marriage
description: At the conclusion of The Sign of the Four, Watson proposes to Mary Morstan once it becomes clear the Agra treasure has been lost — preserving his honour by waiting until she is no longer an heiress. Their marriage takes place shortly thereafter (the canon does not give an exact date; scholarship places it late 1888 or early 1889). Watson moves out of 221B Baker Street to establish his own medical practice in Paddington. The marriage explains his intermittent availability across the Adventures and Memoirs era — Watson visits Holmes when his practice is slow, and Mary's mild patience with the relationship is alluded to in passing. Holmes notes the loss of his Boswell with characteristic restraint.
